main_issue: Who works the first day around Deepavali (A, B and D all want it off; C will work if given Christmas off), and whether to settle it by drawing lots

A-B.evidence: B proposed A work the first day (11); A objected (14, 16); A accepts a draw (21) and sides with D (27) while B refuses to draw (22, 25)

A-C.evidence: C offers to work Deepavali for Christmas off (3, 9, 12); A never speaks to C's offer or Christmas, and only benefits indirectly

A-D.evidence: D backs A's fairness objection (18) and proposes a draw (20); A agrees to a draw (21) and 'He has a point' (27)

B-C.evidence: B builds on C's offer to work (8, 11); C says that sorts out Deepavali (12) but is concerned only with Christmas; B never addresses Christmas

B-D.evidence: B and D both need the first day (11, 10); D proposes a draw (20), B refuses: 'I can't draw for it' (22, 25); D rebuts (24, 26)

C-D.evidence: C's offer to work helps D get days off (3, 12), but neither addresses the other's position directly, and C is silent on the draw
